column1: Being a highly trained observer, you immediately notice a smashed coupe on the sidewalk, and a crowd of rubberneckers milling around nearby. The crowd includes one particularly anxious young man.
column2: 你受過高度訓練，立刻注意到人行道旁撞毀的雙門轎車，以及附近圍觀的人群。其中有個年輕人顯得特別焦慮。

column1: The broken glass of the driver's window has a strange pattern for a car wreck. It appears to be a bullet hole!
column2: 駕駛座車窗的碎玻璃呈現不尋常的車禍形狀。看起來像是彈孔！

column1: You take a deep breath, look in the car, and see a male slumped motionless over the steering wheel.
column2: 你深吸一口氣往車內看，發現一名男子一動也不動地癱在方向盤上。

column1: A closer look reveals a bloody injury to the left side of his head, and a gaping hole in his lower-right jaw!
column2: 仔細一看，他頭部左側有血淋淋的傷口，下顎右下方還有一個大洞！

column1: No pulse. No breathing. No vital signs.
column2: 沒有脈搏、沒有呼吸，也沒有生命跡象。

column1: There is a bullet hole in the driver's window. This is not your normal, everyday traffic accident. In your opinion, this man was murdered!
column2: 駕駛座車窗上有彈孔。這不是普通的交通事故。依你的判斷，這名男子遭到謀殺！

column1: You use your radio to advise Dispatch of the apparent homicide.
column2: 你用無線電向調度中心通報疑似謀殺案。

column1: The car radio crackles a response...
column2: 車上的無線電發出沙沙聲後回應……

column1: Without a radio extender, you can't use your car radio from here.
column2: 沒有無線電延伸器，你無法在這裡使用車上的無線電。

column1: 10-4, 83-32. We copy 187pc homicide.
Be advised, one homicide unit is en route, and the Coroner's Office has been notified. Continue investigation.
column2: 「請注意，一組命案小組正在前往現場，法醫辦公室也已通知。繼續調查。」

column1: You have nothing to report. Investigate the accident scene to see if you can discover something.
column2: 你沒有可報告的事。調查事故現場，看看能否發現什麼。

column1: An excited young man approaches you.
column2: 一名激動的年輕人走近你。

column1: Officer, he says, "I saw what happened! I saw everything!!"
column2: 「警官，」他說，「我看到事情經過！我全都看到了！」

column1: I was buying a paper at the newsstand across the street when I heard the scream of tires, he tells you. "I looked down the street, and here comes this car and a light blue, late-model Cadillac racing down the street side-by-side!"
column2: 「我在街對面的報攤買報紙時，聽到輪胎尖叫聲，」他告訴你。「我往街上一看，就看到這輛車和一輛淺藍色的新款 Cadillac 並排沿街狂奔！」

column1: When they got closer, I heard a 'bang.' I thought one of 'em had a blowout!
column2: 「它們靠近時，我聽到一聲『砰』。我還以為其中一輛爆胎了！」

column1: But, right after that, this car here lost control and crashed. The light blue Caddie just kept on jammin'! he finishes breathlessly.
column2: 「可是緊接著，這輛車失控撞上了。那輛淺藍色 Caddy 繼續狂飆！」他上氣不接下氣地說完。

column1: I think I saw part of his license plate number, 'L964.'
column2: 「我想我看到部分車牌號碼，是『L964』。」

column1: You notify dispatch of the vehicle information.
column2: 你向調度中心通報車輛資訊。

column1: Homicide Detective Oscar Hamilton arrives with Sergeant Dooley.
column2: 命案刑警 Oscar Hamilton 和 Dooley 警佐抵達現場。

column1: Dooley tells you, "Bonds, Detective Hamilton will handle the investigation from here."
column2: Dooley 告訴你：「Bonds，Hamilton 警探會從這裡接手調查。」

column1: Hit the streets and try to find the rat responsible, says Sgt. Dooley. "I'll introduce the witness to Hamilton."
column2: 「上街找出那隻混蛋，」Dooley 警佐說。「我會把證人介紹給 Hamilton。」

column1: The little old lady in the crowd cries out, "Officer, do something. That man is hurt bad! Help him!!"
column2: 人群中的老太太喊道：「警官，快做點什麼。那個人傷得很重！救救他！」

column1: This man is beyond help.
column2: 這名男子已經無法救治。

column1: All I know is, says the witness, %m19
column2: 「我只知道，」證人說，%m19

column1: The green coupe will require a major front-end job!
column2: 這輛綠色轎車的車頭需要大修！

column1: Dooley reminds you, "Ok, Sonny, move it out! That's an order."
column2: Dooley 提醒你：「好了，Sonny，離開現場！這是命令。」

column1: Dooley tells you, "Resume patrol now, Officer Bonds."
column2: Dooley 告訴你：「Bonds 警官，現在恢復巡邏。」

column1: Dooley says, "Anytime now, Bonds. Hit the street!"
column2: Dooley 說：「Bonds，現在就走。上街！」

column1: Dispatch will not hear you unless you use the radio.
column2: 除非使用無線電，否則調度中心聽不到你的通報。

column1: 10-4, 83-32. We copy light blue Cadillac, partial license 'L964.'
column2: 「10-4，83-32。我們收到淺藍色 Cadillac，部分車牌『L964』。」

column1: You have nothing further to report.
column2: 你沒有其他要報告的事。

column1: 10-4, 83-32. Hamilton and Dooley are in route. Estimated time of arrival is momentarily!
column2: 「10-4，83-32。Hamilton 和 Dooley 正在途中，馬上就到！」

column1: It would be more professional to wait until the homicide detectives arrive before leaving the scene.
column2: 等命案刑警抵達後再離開現場，會比較符合專業程序。

column1: You see a man slumped over the wheel.
column2: 你看見一名男子癱在方向盤上。

column1: The crowd appears to be fixated on the wreck.
column2: 人群似乎全都盯著車禍現場。

column1: 10-4, 83-32. We copy 187pc homicide. Continue investigation.
column2: 「10-4，83-32。我們收到 187pc 謀殺案通報。繼續調查。」

column1: %m20 "Dispatch, this is 83-32. Be advised description of suspect vehicle is late-model, light blue Cadillac."
column2: %m20「調度中心，這裡是 83-32。請注意，嫌疑車輛是一輛新款淺藍色 Cadillac。」

column1: The wreck victim's license plate appears to have been lost during the accident.
column2: 車禍受害者的車牌似乎在事故中遺失了。

column1: This car smells of death.
column2: 這輛車散發著死亡的氣味。
